channel.title: The Grant Desk - added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: added in last 30 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 8 new grants - week of 31 Aug 2026
item.description:
8 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 31 Aug 2026 (31 Aug to 06 Sep 2026).

  • University of Johannesburg Artists in Residence 2027
    UJ Arts & Culture, University of Johannesburg · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of ZAR 12,000 per month across a 10-month residency, so roughly ZAR 120,000 in total. No travel or accommodation budget on top of the stipend, and studio or rehearsal space is limited rather than guaranteed. No application fee.
    https://arts.uj.ac.za/artists-in-residence/
  • The Kitchen / Central Location Open Call (foodculture days Biennale, Vevey 2027)
    foodculture days · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · CHF 15,000 all-inclusive project budget (VAT included), covering travel, visas, equipment and additional kitchen equipment rental, per diems, materials and artist fees. Food costs and accommodation in Vevey are covered separately by foodculture days. Three shortlisted collectives each receive a CHF 250 research fee to develop their proposal in Phase 2. One collective is selected. No application fee.
    https://opencall.foodculturedays.com/en
  • The Impart & Nalli Fellowships 2027-28
    Impart in collaboration with Nalli Silks · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 5.5 lakhs (INR 550,000) per fellow towards project execution, covering research-related expenses including travel, fieldwork and documentation subject to approval. Two fellowships are awarded. No application fee.
    https://imp-art.org/fellowship-grant/impart-x-nalli-fellowships/
  • Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Travel Fellowship 2026
    Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Foundation · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Two awards of USD 5,000 each, distributed in the fall of 2026, to fund a research trip that furthers the artist's practice. No application fee.
    https://www.lasellefoundation.org/travel-fellowship
  • ITER 2026: International Touring and Environmental Responsibility Programme
    Julie's Bicycle and in futurum, funded by Arts Council England, Arts Council Norway, Creative Scotland and the Danish Arts Foundation · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · The seminar programme is free to join. Groups of three or more participants can then apply for up to GBP 30,000 for collaborative projects, with funding applications open 6 November 2026 to 11 January 2027 and projects starting spring 2027. No application fee.
    https://juliesbicycle.org/news/iter-2026/
  • Arts Council England: Music Growth Fund, GBP 1,000-40,000 strand
    Arts Council England · deadline 03 Sep 2026 · GBP 1,000 to GBP 40,000, from a total annual budget of GBP 3,000,000 for this strand in 2026/27. You must find at least 25 percent of the total project budget as CASH match funding. No application fee.
    https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/music-growth-package/music-growth-fund-general-guidance
  • Princeton Arts Fellowship 2027-2029 (Lewis Center for the Arts)
    Princeton University, Lewis Center for the Arts · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · USD 93,000 salary per year for each of two academic years, as a full-time 24-month appointment at the rank of Associate Professional Specialist. No application fee.
    https://apply.interfolio.com/187043
  • Artist Grant: Unrestricted $1,200 Visual Artist Grant (November 2026 round)
    Artist Grant · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Unrestricted USD 1,200 grant to one visual artist per round, awarded three times a year. Application fee of USD 30, paid separately via Stripe or PayPal.
    https://artistgrant.org/apply

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 30 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
30 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • Delfina Foundation: Open Call for Curators Based in Central and West Africa (London residency)
    Delfina Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Fully supported: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials and research allowance of GBP 70 per week, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. Supported by Delfina Foundation's Network of Patrons for Africa. No application fee.
    https://www.delfinafoundation.com/open-calls/current/open-call-for-curators-based-in-central-and-west-africa/
  • Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
  • Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/humanrightswatch/jobs/8350654002
  • Dot Line Space Art Foundation: Water Bodies & Ecology 2026 (Mumbai)
    Dot Line Space Art Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Grants towards travel and production expenses for selected artists. The call does not publish fixed amounts and does not state an artist fee or accommodation. No application fee.
    https://www.dotlinespace.co.in/water-bodies-and-ecology-2026/
  • Residing Non-linear Technologies and Sonic Worldings (M-Cult x Titanik, Helsinki and Turku)
    Art and Media Culture Agency M-Cult (Helsinki) and Arte artists' association / Titanik gallery (Turku) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,500 artist fee plus EUR 2,000 production budget, two months' accommodation split between Helsinki and Turku, and one return travel ticket from a Nordic-Baltic country. No application fee stated.
    https://www.titanik.fi/residency-open-call-residing-non-linear-technologies-and-sonic-worldings/
  • BAVC MediaMaker Fellowship 2027
    BAVC Media (Bay Area Video Coalition) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 10,000 distributed to each Fellow over the course of the fellowship, plus travel per diems. Non-cash support includes flights and accommodation for two San Francisco convenings, festival and conference access with travel covered, professional mentorship and strategy sessions, five hours of one-to-one mentorship through MediaMaker Connect, and ongoing workshops. Bay Area fellows also get access to BAVC's co-working space and facilities. No application fee.
    https://bavc.org/programs/mediamaker/
  • True Blue Fellowship 2027
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
  • Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    Archipel Butor · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
  • Sphera Media Lab 2026: Open Call for Masterclasses and Keynotes
    European Lab (Arty Farty) and the Sphera Network, coordinated by Medianes · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Selected contributors receive a fee plus travel to Brussels and accommodation, all covered by the organisers. The fee amount is not published in the call. No submission fee.
    https://arty-farty.typeform.com/to/xnDikGGM
  • Inato Gallery: Touch Some Grass (open-call poster exhibition)
    Inato Gallery · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · No artist fee, stipend or production budget. This is an exhibition opportunity: selected posters are shown in Inato Gallery's Touch Some Grass exhibition. No submission fee is stated in the call.
    https://www.inatogallery.com/open-call
  • DRIFT: Choreographer Open Call 2026-27 (Dance and Research In The Future Time)
    DRIFT, a four-year Creative Europe cooperation of ten organisations led by Theatre de Liege and Maison de la danse · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · EUR 20,000 research budget per choreographer, covering artistic fees, travel, accommodation and optional collaborator costs. Also included: an Onboarding Lab, two weeks of residency with your national DRIFT partner, three collaborative Online Labs, a Festival Lab in Tunis, individual artistic mentoring and individual curatorial mentoring, and a work-in-progress presentation at the Biennale de la danse in Lyon. No application fee.
    https://driftdance.eu/artists/open-call
  • Scuola Piccola Zattere: International Fellowship and Residency 2027 (Venice)
    Scuola Piccola Zattere · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 fellowship grant plus a EUR 2,000 research budget, accommodation in Venice, an individual study space within a shared studio, and round-trip travel to Venice. Collectives and duos share a single grant and one accommodation. No application fee.
    https://scuolapiccolazattere.com/en/events/internationalfellowship-2-3
  • Martin Roth-Initiative: Temporary Relocation for Artists and Cultural Actors at Risk (Programme Line 1, 2026 call)
    Martin Roth-Initiative (Goethe-Institut and ifa, funded by the German Federal Foreign Office) · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · Monthly scholarship for the relocated artist, plus insurance, language courses, psychosocial support, counselling and training, visa support, and personnel funding for the host organisation. No application fee.
    https://www.martin-roth-initiative.de/en/application-programme-line-1
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.
    https://www.fondsbjp.nl/subsidies/
  • Programme PAUSE: Emergency Hosting for Scientists and Artists in Exile (autumn 2026 call)
    Programme PAUSE, hosted by the College de France, with the French Ministries of Higher Education and Research and of Culture · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · PAUSE co-funds the hosting project (salary and support costs) together with the host institution; amounts depend on the project and institution. No application fee.
    https://www.programmepause.fr/en/
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
  • BICA: Generator Fund 2026 (Kinetic and Potential Grants)
    Buffalo Institute for Contemporary Art (BICA) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Two grant types: Kinetic Grants of up to USD 5,000 for short-term, public-facing visual arts projects (exhibitions, performances, installations, workshops, publications), and Potential Grants of up to USD 10,000 for long-term, collaborative or platform-building projects (artist-run spaces, recurring events, media platforms and other structures that extend beyond a single outcome). No application fee. The fund is part of the Andy Warhol Foundation's Regional Regranting Program.
    https://www.generatorfund.org/apply
  • Connect and Create: Circulation of Performing Arts and Music (Africa-Europe) - 2nd Call
    Goethe-Institut and Expertise France, in collaboration with Institut francais (Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture consortium) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 15,000 to EUR 39,500 per project, covering travel, visas, insurance, accommodation, per diems, local transport and shipping of scenographic and technical elements. No application fee.
    https://ifprog.emundus.fr/en/campagne-info?view=programme&cid=353
  • Collar Works: Elizabeth Murray Artist Residency (EMAR) 2027
    Collar Works · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · Fully supported: there is no cost to participate for accepted artists. Private bedroom accommodation with shared bathrooms in the farmhouse, 24-hour access to a semi-private studio in the barn that housed Elizabeth Murray's studio, all food provided (dinner cooked and eaten communally), and use of the property including a swimming pool, pond and 77 acres of fields and woods. Accepted artists also receive a USD 500 stipend to use at their discretion towards travel, materials or other associated costs. The Family Residency additionally provides free full-day (9am to 3pm) childcare as a parallel creative residency for children aged 5 to 12, plus a dedicated Kids Art Studio. APPLICATION FEE: USD 35 (the first month of the application period was free; the fee applies from 1 August 2026).
    https://collarworks.submittable.com/submit/360246/elizabeth-murray-artist-residency-2027
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
  • Physical AI Safety Institute: Research Fellowship (expression of interest)
    Physical AI Safety Institute (PAISI) · deadline Rolling / undated · Stipend amount is not published. Fellows receive a stipend, access to physical robot platforms, compute for simulation and training, and structured mentorship. PAISI was seeded by a grant from BlueDot Impact. Free to submit an expression of interest.
    https://airtable.com/appYKevtFovAswTXz/pagtcy2ye0OeFf04d/form
  • ESA Open Space Innovation Platform (OSIP): rolling open call for ideas
    European Space Agency (ESA) · deadline Rolling / undated · Varies by route and campaign. Successful ideas are supported through PhD or postdoctoral research co-funded by ESA and universities, early technology development activities, or system studies. Free to submit.
    https://www.esa.int/Enabling_Support/Preparing_for_the_Future/Discovery_and_Preparation/The_Open_Space_Innovation_Platform_OSIP
  • Rory Peck Trust: Crisis Fund for Freelance Journalists
    Rory Peck Trust · deadline Rolling / undated · Individual emergency grants; amounts are set case by case from an assessment of circumstances and need. No application fee.
    https://rorypecktrust.org/get-help/crisis/crisis-fund/
  • IIE Scholar Rescue Fund (IIE-SRF) Fellowship for Threatened and Displaced Scholars
    Institute of International Education (IIE), Scholar Rescue Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Fellowship of up to USD 30,000 for one year, paid towards a temporary academic position at a host institution; in most cases renewable for a second and final year. No application fee.
    https://www.iie.org/programs/scholar-rescue-fund/for-scholars/
  • Digital Defenders Partnership: Incident Response Fund
    Digital Defenders Partnership (DDP), hosted by Hivos · deadline Rolling / undated · Rapid-response grants of up to USD 5,000 (historically up to EUR 10,000) for costs that directly reduce the risk or impact of a digital attack, covering activities for a maximum of four months. No application fee.
    https://www.digitaldefenders.org/funds/
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
  • IKSV Young Artist Fund: International Circulation Support Programme (Turkey)
    Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (IKSV) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to EUR 1,300 per recipient towards documented travel costs (economy flights, trains, buses and public transport; accommodation in some cases). No application fee.
    https://www.iksv.org/tr/genc-sanatci-fonu-uluslararasi-dolasim-destek-programi/acik-cagri
  • Apollo Research: (Senior) AI Governance Researcher (London or San Francisco)
    Apollo Research · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 150,000 to 225,000 salary plus equity. Benefits include unlimited vacation and sick leave, up to 6 months paid parental leave, health/dental/vision insurance, employer-matched retirement savings, meals on workdays, paid work trips and retreats, and a USD 1,000 yearly professional development budget. Note: a widely circulated newsletter listing quoted this range in pounds; the posting itself says USD.
    https://jobs.lever.co/apolloresearch/c7377abe-39ac-4712-8d2f-b048f363480a
  • CSET (Georgetown): Frontier AI Research Lead (Research Fellow or Senior Fellow)
    Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), Georgetown University Walsh School of Foreign Service · deadline Rolling / undated · Research Fellow: roughly USD 100,000 to 130,000 per year. Senior Fellow: roughly USD 160,000 to 190,000 per year. Commensurate with experience. Georgetown University benefits. No application fee.
    https://cset.georgetown.edu/job/frontier-ai-research-lead/

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 6 new grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
6 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 17 Aug 2026 (17 Aug to 23 Aug 2026).

  • Sundance Institute: Episodic Program and Lab 2027
    Sundance Institute · deadline Closed 25 Aug 2026 · No stipend or honorarium for participation. For the in-person Lab, Sundance covers round-trip basic economy airfare from the airport nearest the fellow's residence, shared housing with a private room and bath, and ground transport to and from the airport (fellows within 100 miles of the Lab get ground transport only). Meals, in-room charges, travel insurance, luggage fees and taxes are the fellow's own cost. One selected project also receives a separate monetary grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation for a series with an illuminating emphasis on science, including medicine, energy, technology or invention. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 nonrefundable processing fee per project submitted.
    https://filmfreeway.com/SundanceEpisodicLab2027
  • University of East Anglia: Deputy Dean, CUCN-UEA Digital Creativity Institute
    University of East Anglia (UEA), Faculty of Arts and Humanities · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · GBP 69,488 to 73,709 per annum depending on qualifications and experience, plus the standard UEA pension and leave package. No application fee.
    https://vacancies.uea.ac.uk/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx
  • JUGAAD: Absolute Improvisation, open call for printed matter and small-format works (Amsterdam)
    SAC Art Amsterdam and Mama Magnet · deadline 05 Sep 2026 · No application fee. Selected work is sold at the printed matter fair on mutually agreeable terms regarding commission, duration and number of editions; artists are remunerated within 30 days of each sale. Unsold works are returned at the end of the agreed consignment period.
    https://sacartamsterdam.com/upcoming-programmes/
  • Utrecht University: PhD, Media and Democracy in the 1970s (NWO Vidi project)
    Utrecht University, Faculty of Humanities, Department of History and Art History · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · EUR 3,059 to 3,881 gross per month at 36 to 40 hours per week, on the Dutch university PhD scale, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and 8.3 percent year-end bonus. No application fee.
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362200/phd-media-and-democracy-in-the-1970s/
  • KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
  • Studio ALTA Residence 2027: four residency open calls (Prague)
    Studio ALTA · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Residency fees paid to participants: Research House CZK 12,000 per project; Rest House CZK 6,000 per person; House in the Neighborhood CZK 30,000 per project; House of Sweat CZK 15,000 per project. All include workspace at Studio ALTA; the two production residencies add dramaturgic, production, technical and PR support. Free to apply.
    https://www.altart.cz/rezidence-2027/

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 03 Aug 2026 (03 Aug to 09 Aug 2026).

  • Wave Hill: 2027 Sunroom Project Space (NYC)
    Wave Hill · deadline Closed 09 Aug 2026 · $2,000 honorarium per artist, plus exhibition and professional development support, a co-designed Meet the Artist public program, and a short exhibition essay published in print and online. Four artists selected. No application fee.
    https://wavehill.slideroom.com/#/login/program/89416
